verses.zh: 雅基的儿子亚古珥的言语就是真言。这人对以铁和乌甲说：
verses.kjv: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
verses.en: The words of Agur son of Jakeh — what he said to Ithiel and to Ucal:

verses.zh: 我比众人更蠢笨，也没有人的聪明。
verses.kjv: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
verses.en: I am more stupid than anyone else; I do not have the understanding a person should have.

verses.zh: 我没有学好智慧，也不认识至圣者。
verses.kjv: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
verses.en: I never learned wisdom, and I do not know the Holy One.

verses.zh: 谁升天又降下来？谁聚风在掌握中？谁包水在衣服里？谁立定地的四极？他名叫什么？他儿子名叫什么？你知道吗？
verses.kjv: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son’s name, if thou canst tell?
verses.en: Who has gone up to heaven and come down? Who has gathered the wind in his hands? Who has wrapped up the waters in a cloak? Who set the ends of the earth in place? What is his name, and his son's name? Do you know?

verses.zh: 神的言语句句都是炼净的；投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。
verses.kjv: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
verses.en: Every word of God is pure; he is a shield to everyone who trusts him.

verses.zh: 他的言语，你不可加添，恐怕他责备你，你就显为说谎言的。
verses.kjv: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
verses.en: Do not add to his words, or he will correct you and you will be shown up as a liar.

verses.zh: 我求你两件事，在我未死之先，不要不赐给我：
verses.kjv: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
verses.en: I ask you for two things; do not say no to me before I die:

verses.zh: 求你使虚假和谎言远离我；使我也不贫穷也不富足；赐给我需用的饮食，
verses.kjv: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
verses.en: Keep lying and cheating far from me. Do not make me poor or rich; just give me the food I need,

verses.zh: 恐怕我饱足不认你，说：耶和华是谁呢？又恐怕我贫穷就偷窃，以致亵渎我神的名。
verses.kjv: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.
verses.en: or I might be full and say, "Who is the LORD?" — or be poor and steal, and shame God's name.

verses.zh: 你不要向主人谗谤仆人，恐怕他咒诅你，你便算为有罪。
verses.kjv: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
verses.en: Do not tell tales about a servant to his master, or he will curse you and you will be in the wrong.

verses.zh: 有一宗人，咒诅父亲，不给母亲祝福。
verses.kjv: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
verses.en: There are people who curse their fathers and never bless their mothers.

verses.zh: 有一宗人，自以为清洁，却没有洗去自己的污秽。
verses.kjv: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
verses.en: There are people who think they are clean, but have never washed off their dirt.

verses.zh: 有一宗人，眼目何其高傲，眼皮也是高举。
verses.kjv: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.en: There are people whose eyes are so proud, whose eyelids are lifted so high.

verses.zh: 有一宗人，牙如剑，齿如刀，要吞灭地上的困苦人和世间的穷乏人。
verses.kjv: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
verses.en: There are people whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are knives, eating up the poor and needy of the earth.

verses.zh: 蚂蟥有两个女儿，常说：给呀，给呀！有三样不知足的，连不说「够的」共有四样：
verses.kjv: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
verses.en: The leech has two daughters who cry, "Give! Give!" There are three things never satisfied, four that never say "enough":

verses.zh: 就是阴间和石胎，浸水不足的地，并火。
verses.kjv: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
verses.en: the grave, a womb with no child, land that never gets enough water, and fire.

verses.zh: 戏笑父亲、藐视而不听从母亲的，他的眼睛必为谷中的乌鸦啄出来，为鹰雏所吃。
verses.kjv: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
verses.en: The eye that laughs at a father and refuses to obey a mother will be pecked out by the ravens of the valley and eaten by young eagles.

verses.zh: 我所测不透的奇妙有三样，连我所不知道的共有四样：
verses.kjv: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
verses.en: There are three things too wonderful for me, four I cannot work out:

verses.zh: 就是鹰在空中飞的道；蛇在磐石上爬的道；船在海中行的道；男与女交合的道。
verses.kjv: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
verses.en: the way an eagle flies in the sky, the way a snake moves over a rock, the way a ship sails the sea, and the way a man is with a young woman.

verses.zh: 淫妇的道也是这样：她吃了，把嘴一擦就说：我没有行恶。
verses.kjv: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
verses.en: This is the way of a woman who breaks her marriage: she eats, wipes her mouth, and says, "I have done nothing wrong."

verses.zh: 使地震动的有三样，连地担不起的共有四样：
verses.kjv: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
verses.en: Three things make the earth shake, four it cannot put up with:

verses.zh: 就是仆人作王；愚顽人吃饱；
verses.kjv: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
verses.en: a servant who becomes king, a fool who has eaten his fill,

verses.zh: 丑恶的女子出嫁；婢女接续主母。
verses.kjv: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
verses.en: a hateful woman who gets married, and a servant girl who takes her mistress's place.

verses.zh: 地上有四样小物，却甚聪明：
verses.kjv: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
verses.en: There are four things on earth that are small, but very wise:

verses.zh: 蚂蚁是无力之类，却在夏天预备粮食。
verses.kjv: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
verses.en: ants are not strong, yet they store up their food in summer;

verses.zh: 沙番是软弱之类，却在磐石中造房。
verses.kjv: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
verses.en: rock badgers are not powerful, yet they make their homes in the cliffs;

verses.zh: 蝗虫没有君王，却分队而出。
verses.kjv: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
verses.en: locusts have no king, yet they all march out in ranks;

verses.zh: 守宫用爪抓墙，却住在王宫。
verses.kjv: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings’ palaces.
verses.en: a lizard can be caught in your hand, yet it lives in kings' palaces.

verses.zh: 步行威武的有三样，连行走威武的共有四样：
verses.kjv: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
verses.en: There are three things that walk proudly, four that move beautifully:

verses.zh: 就是狮子—乃百兽中最为猛烈、无所躲避的，
verses.kjv: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
verses.en: a lion, strongest of the animals, that turns back from nothing;

verses.zh: 猎狗，公山羊，和无人能敌的君王。
verses.kjv: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
verses.en: a strutting rooster, a male goat, and a king with his army around him.

verses.zh: 你若行事愚顽，自高自傲，或是怀了恶念，就当用手捂口。
verses.kjv: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
verses.en: If you have been foolish and full of yourself, or planned something bad, put your hand over your mouth,

verses.zh: 摇牛奶必成奶油；扭鼻子必出血。照样，激动怒气必起争端。
verses.kjv: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
verses.en: because churning milk makes butter, twisting a nose makes it bleed, and stirring up anger makes a fight.
